description: This file defines a template mock class MockStringIterator for testing, which implements the IStringIterator interface from WPEFramework::RPC namespace. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for the iterator functionalities.

classes.name: MockStringIterator
classes.description: A template mock class implementing WPEFramework::RPC::IStringIterator for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns true if the iterator advanced successfully to the next element.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Returns true if the iterator moved to the previous element.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position identified by an index.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the collection.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the iterator object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the iterator object.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Provides a way to query for different interfaces supported by the object.
